samples.error: AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: governed cancellation must stop the exact PostgreSQL query before the fixture rolls back its holder

rootCause: work_items:get races already-started checkpoint metadata read against caller abort, while the raw metadata SELECT receives no signal and remains active. Prior guard released the holder before checking query cancellation.
alternativeFalsified: Normal asynchronous PG cancellation settles within the five-second pre-rollback observation window. The same query stayed active throughout while the same holder remained locked.
scope: Deliberate recurrence-guard red with successful private teardown; not a full suite/gate failure or historical6657 root-cause claim.
